episodes.title: Stratasys Snags Markforged: Fire Sale or Smart Play?
episodes.description: Stratasys is buying Markforged from Nano Dimension for $42.5 million, but the metal binder jetting line got left on the curb. We dig into what this means for Markforged users and the composite printing market. Plus, a $185K dual-laser metal printer from Mastrex, Northrop Grumman bets on Norsk Titanium for structural flight parts, and Decathlon's Kiprun launches a 3D-printed running shoe that could actually show up in your local store.

episodes.title: AI Takes Over 3D Printing: ORNL's Real-Time Correction and More
episodes.description: Oak Ridge National Lab's AI system corrects 3D printing errors in real time—but is it really lights-out? Plus, Norsk Titanium inks a production contract with Northrop Grumman, Decathlon's Kiprun launches a 3D printed running shoe, and an IPO that smells like biotech hype. We dig into the week's additive manufacturing news and separate signal from noise.
